audit.why: Urgot owns levels 1-5, level 6 is even, and he stays ahead in the 1v1 at items. Sides and ratings agree with the 43.28% win rate over 201 games and with the mirror.
audit.corrected: No side or rating changes. The content whys[] were shifted one row against their labels (whys[4] described level 5, whys[5] described level 6) and are re-keyed to Level 6 / First item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text called Echoing Flames 'true-damage legs'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Echoing Flames deals physical damage. Wuju Style (E) is the true damage in this matchup, and it is yours, not his. Purge scales to 0 cost and 0 cooldown at rank 5, which is his real per-rank spike.
audit.corrected: Echoing Flames named without the true-damage claim; Purge's rank-5 zero-cooldown written into the late spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and early called the flip 'Corrosive Charge (E)' and the shield a '(Q) shotgun-knee'. Both slots are swapped.
audit.why: Corrosive Charge is Q (800 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s). Disdain is E (475 range, 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s) and carries the shield and the hurl. The range gap against Alpha Strike's 600 is the actual reason he out-pokes you.
audit.corrected: Q named as Corrosive Charge with its 800 range, E named as Disdain with its shield, hurl and 16s rank-1 cooldown, and the catch re-keyed to your Alpha Strike landing rather than 'cancels your dash' — Alpha Strike is untargetable in flight.

audit.why: The wants.foe[2] 'Fear Beyond Death' flag from suspectNames is a false positive — that is the exact Riot name for his R.

edits.before: Urgot shoves the wave and pokes you off it with Purge (W) and his shotgun-knee (Q) shield, out-ranging your Alpha Strike (Q) entirely. His Corrosive Charge (E) flip stops your dash and knocks you back, and Purge shreds you faster than Meditate can heal. You have no safe way to engage — just soak XP and lose CS.
edits.after: Urgot shoves and pokes you off the wave with Corrosive Charge (Q), an 800-range shell against your 600-range Alpha Strike. Disdain (E) is the shielded charge that hurls you away, and Purge (W) shreds faster than Meditate heals. Step up only when Disdain is down — otherwise soak XP and lose the CS.

edits.before: Late is still Urgot-favoured: his passive true-damage legs and R execute punish you for committing, and Purge shreds even your attack speed. Your best path is to avoid dueling entirely — farm side lanes, group, and let your team peel while you clean up fights he isn't in.
edits.after: Late is still Urgot-favoured: Echoing Flames legs and the Fear Beyond Death execute punish every commit, and rank-5 Purge costs nothing and has no cooldown at all. Avoid duelling entirely — farm side lanes, group, and clean up the fights he isn't in with Highlander resets.

edits.before: Urgot dominates you 1-4: he out-ranges your Alpha Strike (Q) with Purge (W) and his knee-shot (Q), shoves the wave into your tower, and pokes you every time you go for CS. His Corrosive Charge (E) flip cancels your dash and knocks you away, and there's no trade window where your Meditate can out-heal his sustained shred. Farm carefully and expect to concede the lane.
edits.after: Urgot dominates you 1-4: Corrosive Charge (Q) reaches 800 units against your 600-range Alpha Strike, he shoves into your tower, and pokes you every time you go for CS. Disdain (E) is a 16s charge that shields him and hurls you away as you land, and no trade window lets Meditate out-heal his shred. Farm carefully and expect to concede the lane.

edits.before: The lane stays Urgot's through items: his true-damage legs, Purge shred, and R execute punish every commit, and his E flip still cancels your combo even after Wuju true damage. Don't try to out-duel him — out-farm, split to a side lane, and win the game in fights he isn't part of, cleaning up with Highlander resets.
edits.after: The lane stays Urgot's through items: Echoing Flames legs, Purge shred, and his R execute punish every commit, and Disdain still hurls you out of the combo even after Wuju Style's true damage. Don't out-duel him — out-farm, split to a side lane, and win the fights he isn't part of, cleaning up with Highlander resets.

edits.after: Level 3 Disdain catches your Alpha Strike landing, no trade.

edits.after: At 6 Highlander's slow immunity offsets his new R: even.
